messages:
maya: Quick sync on compact roles UI — want to nail invite flow + SSO visibility. Fig link: https://figma.redwood/compact-roles

devin: Love compact cards. Concern: tiny SSO lock next to name gets lost on mobile.

liz: Also color for secondary chips fails contrast at small text. I'll run tokens.

sam: Suggest explicit SSO line under role selector: short copy like 'Will sign in via org SSO'. Easier for keyboard flow.

a11y-bot: Automated: tab order issue — current prototype focuses chips before email input. Recommend order: email -> role -> sso -> invite.

aria: Screen reader tip: collapse header should announce role + summary + SSO. Example aria-label: 'Admin, full access, SSO enforced'.

devin: Performance note: avoid nested shadow DOM in each card for compact mode. Eng-platform prefers flat DOM.

maya: Actions: liz update colors, aria fix tab order, dev team flatten DOM, sam draft SSO row copy. Reconvene Thu 10am PT.
